object.prompt: Create an ancient magical rune mounted on a small, solid stone pedestal, matching the exact architectural design, proportions, materials and visual style of the other Guardian Ruins runes. The pedestal is constructed from aged charcoal-gray stone, with masonry blocks, chipped corners, deep cracks, worn edges and subtle dark teal moss in its crevices. On its front-facing central surface, carve a large circular rune containing an intricate symmetrical spiral pattern, surrounded by delicate ancient geometric markings. The circular symbol emits a restrained cyan and turquoise magical glow, with faint blue-green illumination reflecting onto the weathered stone. Include a few tiny magical particles near the symbol. The object should feel mysterious, ancient and monumental despite its compact size. Side view, centered composition, complete pedestal visible, transparent background. High-quality dark fantasy pixel art, crisp individual pixels, controlled shading and limited palette. No blur, no antialiasing, no text, no characters.
